claim: Weakest-link aggregation is the conservative endpoint of a parameterized operator family controlled by a single pessimism parameter.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by constructing a parameterized family of aggregation operators and verifying that the weakest-link operator emerges as the limit when the pessimism parameter is maximized.

conditions: within a parameterized operator family that includes weakest-link and other aggregation modes
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the theoretical frameworks reviewed (chain-of-thought analysis, possibilistic logic, algebraic theory); transfer to other aggregation contexts is unestablished.

title: Aggregation operators in structured–weakest-link aggregation as theorem
